crossRefs.note: God created man in his own image. In God’s image he created him; male and female he created them.
Yahweh God formed man from the dust of the ground, and breathed into his nostrils the breath of life; and man became a…
Yahweh God said, “It is not good for the man to be alone. I will make him a helper comparable to him.”
Yahweh God made a woman from the rib which he had taken from the man, and brought her to the man.
For man is not from woman, but woman from man;
for man wasn’t created for the woman, but woman for the man.
